# Layer-shell protocol

`wlr-layer-shell-unstable-v1.xml` is vendored from
[swaywm/wlr-protocols](https://github.com/swaywm/wlr-protocols/blob/b010a03648b88d143236de193bddbfea0c08bc84/unstable/wlr-layer-shell-unstable-v1.xml),
revision `b010a03648b88d143236de193bddbfea0c08bc84`.
The copyright and permissive license are preserved inside the XML.

The standalone probe binds version 1; the application backend binds up to version 4. Generated C/headers stay in `build/`.
The xdg-shell XML is supplied by the system `wayland-protocols` package.
